=== README.md ===

# Proof of Conjecture 7.7 on the Second-Order Variance Constant of Multinomial Discrete Total Variation

[![Lean 4.35.0 Verify and Comparator](https://github.com/0thernes/multinomial-tv-conjecture/actions/workflows/lean-verify.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/0thernes/multinomial-tv-conjecture/actions/workflows/lean-verify.yml)
[![Cross-Platform CI](https://github.com/0thernes/multinomial-tv-conjecture/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/0thernes/multinomial-tv-conjecture/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![Lean Blueprint](https://img.shields.io/badge/Lean%204-Interactive%20Blueprint-0284c7)](https://0thernes.github.io/multinomial-tv-conjecture/blueprint/)
[![License: Apache-2.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/Code%20License-Apache--2.0-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Docs: CC BY 4.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/Paper%20%26%20Docs-CC%20BY%204.0-lightgrey.svg)](LICENSE-DOCS)
[![Project Status: Active](https://www.repostatus.org/badges/latest/active.svg)](https://www.repostatus.org/#active)

A **Lean 4.35.0** proof of **Conjecture 7.7 (`conj:atriangle`)** and the complete quantitative $O(L^{-2})$ remainder of **Lemma 7.3** of Nikola Banić and Neven Elezović, *Discrete total variation under the multinomial, Part 2: variance under the uniform null* (`arXiv:2610.17046v1`, posted 2026-10-12). The source is an arXiv v1 preprint with no journal reference; it has not been peer reviewed. Part 5 of the same series (`arXiv:2611.14735v1`, Remark 3.11) still lists the closed form as unproved. The repository also contains independent exact-rational and 80-digit Python checks, a Lean 4 Blueprint, an isolated source-code mutation audit, and an AMS-LaTeX manuscript.

Lean also checks five algebraic identities: the result of inserting the proved constants into the Banić–Elezović formulas for $\gamma(n)$, $\gamma(3; N)$ (both rearranged and in the literal Part 2 §7.2 source form `2 p_1(3) + 2 [b_{N mod 3} - 7/(96π)]`), $\gamma(4; N)$ (Part 2, Theorem 7.6, §7.2, and §8), and $\gamma_c(n)$ (Part 5, Theorem 3.10). Lean defines no random variable or variance. That these expressions are the $N^{-2}$ variance coefficients is the content of those cited theorems, which are not formalized here.

The 10 target theorems of `Challenge.lean` and the declarations they depend on are replayed in CI by `lake comparator --paranoid`, which makes **six checker runs**: the Lean kernel in paranoid and in default mode, `lean4lean`, `nanoda`, `con-leche`, and `con-ron` (two of the six runs are the Lean kernel). Separately, `NonVacuity.lean` is independently replayed in CI via `lake env leanchecker MultinomialTVConjecture.NonVacuity`.

**Author:** Alexander Stephen Donahue · Independent Researcher, Spokane, WA, USA · ORCID [0009-0006-8168-9648](https://orcid.org/0009-0006-8168-9648) · `0_0@0thernes.art`
**Status:** Active research preprint (`v2.7.0`, 2026-11-27) — **NOT externally peer reviewed**, and the source conjecture is itself from an unrefereed arXiv v1 preprint; independent human line-by-line statement-fidelity audit and external operator replication remain open (see [docs/statement-fidelity.md](docs/statement-fidelity.md), [REPLICATION.md](REPLICATION.md), and [LIMITATIONS.md](LIMITATIONS.md)). All corrections from the 2026-11-26 statement audit and subsequent hardening rounds are logged in [ERRATA.md](ERRATA.md).

![Multinomial TV Conjecture v2.7.0 Overview and Verification Stack](docs/media/social-preview.svg)

*(Regenerable from current code & logs via `python3 scripts/generate_social_preview.py`.)*

## Main Theorem (Conjecture 7.7 & Quantitative Lemma 7.3 Proved)

For $(X_1, X_2, X_3) \sim \mathrm{Mult}(L; \tfrac{1}{3}, \tfrac{1}{3}, \tfrac{1}{3})$, define the adjacent pair expectation $h_{\mathrm{adj}}(L) := \mathbb{E}[|X_2 - X_1|\,|X_3 - X_2|]$, $c_L := \frac{2\sqrt{3}}{3\pi} + \frac{1}{9}$, and $a_* := -\frac{2\sqrt{3}}{9\pi}$. For each residue class $r \in \{0, 1, 2\}$, the $1/L$-order limit
$$b_r := \lim_{\substack{L \to \infty \\ L \equiv r \pmod{3}}} L\bigl(h_{\mathrm{adj}}(L) - c_L L - a_*\bigr)$$
exists and equals:

$$b_0 = \frac{32\sqrt{3}}{81\pi}, \qquad b_1 = b_2 = -\frac{22\sqrt{3}}{81\pi}, \qquad d_0 = \frac{b_0 + b_1 + b_2}{3} = -\frac{4\sqrt{3}}{81\pi},$$

$$b_r = d_0 + \frac{4\sqrt{3}}{9\pi}\cos\!\left(\frac{2\pi r}{3}\right) \quad (r \in \{0, 1, 2\}),$$

$$a_\triangle = \frac{1}{32} + \frac{\pi}{9}(b_0 + b_1 + b_2) = \frac{1}{32} - \frac{4\sqrt{3}}{243}, \qquad \gamma_2 = \frac{64 a_\triangle - 3}{32\pi} = -\frac{1}{32\pi} - \frac{8\sqrt{3}}{243\pi},$$

together with the quantitative Lemma 7.3 remainder bound $\exists C \ge 0,\;\forall L \ge 1,\;|h_{\mathrm{adj}}(L) - c_L L - a_* - b_{L\bmod 3}/L| \le C/L^2$ (`lemma_7_3_O_inv_sq`).

This removes the sole conjectural input from the Banić–Elezović formulas below. Assuming Theorem 7.6 of Part 2 (`arXiv:2610.17046v1`) and Theorem 3.10 of Part 5 (`arXiv:2611.14735v1`), which are cited and not formalized here, inserting $a_\triangle$ gives the following $N^{-2}$ variance coefficients for $n \ge 5$. Lean checks only the algebra of this substitution, for real $n \ne 0$:
$$\gamma(n) = -\frac{n(n+1)}{32\pi} - \frac{8\sqrt{3}\,n(n-2)}{243\pi} + \frac{n-1}{8\pi n}, \qquad \gamma_c(n) = -\frac{n(n+4)}{32\pi} - \frac{8\sqrt{3}\,n^2}{243\pi}.$$

## Axiom Audit (Excerpt of `#print axioms` Output)

The Lean sources contain **191 author-written theorems and lemmas**. `Lean.collectAxioms` in [lean/VerifyAxioms.lean](lean/VerifyAxioms.lean) checks all **896 theorem constants** the compiler emits for them (191 author-written + 705 compiler-generated auxiliaries) **plus all 65 project definitions** across all 10 `module`-header Lean 4.35.0 files (`autoImplicit = false`, `weak.linter.mathlibStandardSet = true`, **0 `@[nolint]` suppressions**). Every one depends only on Lean's three standard axioms `[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]`. There is **no `sorry`**, **no `admit`**, **no custom `axiom`**, **no `native_decide`**, **no `unsafe`**, and **no `@[nolint]`** in `lean/MultinomialTVConjecture/` or `lean/Solution.lean`.

## Comparator Check and Non-Vacuity Witnesses

To separate statement auditing from proof internals, every Lean file carries a Lean 4.35.0 `module` header (Palomar Registry spec) with zero `@[nolint]` suppressions, and [lean/Challenge.lean](lean/Challenge.lean) (164 lines) imports **only Mathlib** (zero files from our proof library) and states the 10 targets: the three residue-class limits and Conjecture 7.7 (targets 1–4), the five algebraic identities behind Corollary 1.2(i)–(iii) (targets 5–8 and 10, with target 10 stating the literal Part 2 §7.2 `n = 3` source expression and proving its equivalence `q_1(3) - d_0 = -7/(96π)` with target 7, and target 8 carrying `(-1)^N/(2π)` unchanged on both sides), and the quantitative $O(L^{-2})$ Lemma 7.3 remainder bound (target 9). [lean/Solution.lean](lean/Solution.lean) proves those declarations without `sorry`, and `lake comparator --config comparator.json --paranoid` replays the 10 targets and the declarations they depend on in **six checker runs** (the Lean kernel in paranoid and default mode, `lean4lean`, `nanoda`, `con-leche`, `con-ron`), paired in CI with a live negative `sorry`-tamper comparator rejection test. Separately, `NonVacuity.lean` is independently replayed in CI via `lake env leanchecker MultinomialTVConjecture.NonVacuity`, where the false value $a_\triangle = 1/32$ and a zero-constant $O(L^{-2})$ remainder are refuted by `adversarial_aTriangle_ne_one_div_32` and `adversarial_lemma_7_3_zero_const_false`.

| Verification Check | Tool / File | Scope |
|---|---|---|
| **Lean kernel** | `lean 4.35.0` / `lake build` (`module` headers, `0` `@[nolint]`) | 191 author-written theorems and lemmas (896 theorem constants + 65 definitions) across `MultinomialTVConjecture`, `Solution`, `VerifyAxioms`; no warnings except the 10 intentional `sorry` warnings of the statement-only `Challenge.lean` |
| **Comparator checker runs** | `lake comparator --config comparator.json --paranoid` (Lean kernel in paranoid and default mode, `lean4lean`, `nanoda 0.4.19`, `con-leche`, `con-ron`) | All 10 targets (incl. `target_lemma_7_3_O_inv_sq` & literal §7.2 `target_gamma3_source_form`) and their dependencies (`Challenge.lean` vs. `Solution.lean`) + live negative `sorry`-tamper rejection check |
| **Standalone `NonVacuity` replay** | `lake env leanchecker MultinomialTVConjecture.NonVacuity` | Independent kernel replay of all 22 theorems in `NonVacuity.lean` (6 direct `hAdj 0..5` definition checks + 16 sign, witness, and false-constant/non-degeneracy refutation corollaries covering all 10 targets) |
| **Exhaustive axiom audit** | `lean/VerifyAxioms.lean` (`Lean.collectAxioms`) | 896/896 theorem constants (191 author-written, 705 compiler-generated) + 65/65 definitions strictly within `[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]` |
| **Batteries & Mathlib linters** | `lake exe runLinter MultinomialTVConjecture` & `weak.linter.mathlibStandardSet = true` | 0 warnings and **0 `@[nolint]` suppressions** across Batteries + Mathlib style linters (`autoImplicit = false`) |
| **Exact rational, differential & code-mutation audit** | `scripts/verify_conjecture.py`, `scripts/run_mutation_audit.py` & `tests/` | Exact `Fraction` ($L=3..45$, 0/1 error); 3,000+ Hypothesis cases; 1,140-input differential oracle; 24/24 isolated code mutants killed across 7 scripts; 28-pt Richardson error $< 3 \times 10^{-55}$ (>54 digits) |

See [docs/statement-fidelity.md](docs/statement-fidelity.md) for the declaration-by-declaration mapping to Banić & Elezović (`arXiv:2610.17046v1`), and [CLAIMS.md](CLAIMS.md) for explicit falsification criteria ("What Would Prove Us Wrong").

## Quickstart

Verify the formal proof and independent numerical checks from a clean clone:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/0thernes/multinomial-tv-conjecture.git
cd multinomial-tv-conjecture

# 1. Install pinned Python verification & test dependencies
python3 -m pip install -r requirements.txt

# 2. Fetch pinned Mathlib cache, build Lean 4.35.0 proofs, audit axioms & run the comparator (six checker runs)
cd lean
lake exe cache get
lake build MultinomialTVConjecture Challenge Solution VerifyAxioms
lake env lean VerifyAxioms.lean
lake comparator --config comparator.json --paranoid   # Linux with bubblewrap
cd ..

# 3. Run independent exact rational + 80-digit checks, pytest ladder, citations, Blueprint & repo audit
python3 scripts/verify_conjecture.py
python3 -m pytest -v tests/
python3 scripts/check_citations.py
python3 scripts/check_readme_axioms.py --require-exhaustive
python3 scripts/build_blueprint.py
python3 scripts/build_site.py
```

Full step-by-step instructions for Linux, macOS, and Windows appear in [REPLICATION.md](REPLICATION.md).

---

## Usage

Common one-word workflows via `just` (see [justfile](justfile) and [scripts/dev.sh](scripts/dev.sh)):

```bash
just verify-lean     # Build Lean, scan forbidden tokens, run VerifyAxioms + comparator (Linux)
just verify-numeric  # Run exact rational (L=3..45) and 80-digit mpmath checks
just test            # Run full pytest ladder (exact, Hypothesis, negative, regression, golden, mutation, stability)
just blueprint       # Validate every \lean{...} tag and build interactive SVG dependency Blueprint
just paper           # Compile AMS-LaTeX preprint via Tectonic & build byte-reproducible arXiv bundle
just reproduce       # End-to-end clean reproduction & Build Standard v1.2.0 audit
just audit           # Score repository against Build Standard v1.2.0 (90 items)
```

| `blueprint/src/content.tex` | Lean 4 dependency Blueprint validated against `lean/` by `scripts/build_blueprint.py` |
| `scripts/` | Independent numerical verifier, Lean token scanner (`check_lean_tokens.py`), isolated code mutation runner (`run_mutation_audit.py`), SVG preview generator (`generate_social_preview.py`), arXiv bundler, X.509-verified dual timestamp stamper, axiom/citation/Blueprint/site/manifest/Build Standard scripts |

| `docs/` | Architecture, statement-fidelity table, verification stack, literature search, ADRs, threat model, operations, FAQ, glossary, red-team review |
| `results/`, `data/MANIFEST.sha256*` | Live axiom/comparator/linter/citation/mutation logs, 32-file SHA-256 manifest, X.509-verified DigiCert RFC 3161 `.tsr`, and Bitcoin OpenTimestamps `.ots` |

# AGENTS.md — Canonical Agent Instructions (`multinomial-tv-conjecture`)

This file is the **single canonical instruction file** for all AI coding agents working in `multinomial-tv-conjecture` (`CLAUDE.md`, `GEMINI.md`, and `.cursor/rules/build-standard.mdc` point here).

## Project Identity & Mission

- **Repository:** `https://github.com/0thernes/multinomial-tv-conjecture`
- **Author:** Alexander Stephen Donahue (`Independent Researcher, Spokane, WA, USA`, ORCID `0009-0006-8168-9648`, email `0_0@0thernes.art`). **NEVER** reintroduce `0thernes LLC` (unformed legal entity).
- **Subject:** Complete Lean 4.35.0 formal proof (replayed in six checker runs via `lake comparator --paranoid`), independent exact/80-digit Python verification, interactive Blueprint, and AMS-LaTeX preprint proving **Conjecture 7.7** (`conj:atriangle`) and the quantitative $O(L^{-2})$ Lemma 7.3 remainder of Banić & Elezović (`arXiv:2610.17046v1`, 2026) together with the algebraic identities behind its cyclic corollary (`arXiv:2611.14735v1`, Theorem 3.10).
- **Licenses:** Code (`lean/`, `scripts/`, `tests/`, `.github/`) is **Apache-2.0** (`LICENSE`); manuscript and docs (`paper/`, `docs/`, `blueprint/`, `*.md`) are **CC-BY-4.0** (`LICENSE-DOCS`).

## Hard Rules (Build Standard v1.2.0 `R1`–`R8` & Verification Playbook v1.3)

1. **R1 / R2 (Solo-maintainer workflow):** Commit and push straight to `main`. Never create branch protection, PR templates, feature branches for routine work, commit signing requirements, or blocking git hooks.
2. **R3 (Informational CI):** All linters (`ruff`, `mypy`, `gitleaks`, Batteries `runLinter`) run report-only. Never fake a passing check.
3. **R4 (Zero banned files):** Never create `PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md`, `dependabot.yml`, `renovate.json`, `.github/copilot-instructions.md`, or `FUNDING.yml`.
4. **R5 / R6 (Zero fabrication):** Never fabricate `#print axioms` output, test passes, SHA-256 hashes, DOIs, arXiv IDs, or external peer-review claims. Always run the real tool on the current code.
5. **R7 (10-class finding taxonomy):** Classify every defect/finding into exactly one of: `bug`, `error`, `issue`, `problem`, `concern`, `dilemma`, `conflict`, `gap`, `hole`, `blindspot`.
6. **Lean soundness invariant:** Zero `sorry`, `admit`, `axiom`, `native_decide`, `unsafe`, `implemented_by`, or `@[extern]` in `lean/MultinomialTVConjecture/` or `lean/Solution.lean`. (`lean/Challenge.lean` intentionally holds 10 target `sorry` stubs verified against sorry-free `lean/Solution.lean` by `lake comparator`.)
7. **Single version source:** `VERSION` must match `CHANGELOG.md`, `CITATION.cff`, `formalization.yaml`, and `lean/lakefile.toml`.

=== CLAIMS.md ===

# Claims Ledger (`CLAIMS.md`)

Every mathematical and computational claim in this repository is numbered, assigned an exact verification tier, mapped to its Lean 4 declaration / script / test, and paired with an explicit falsification criterion (**what would prove us wrong**).

**Source status.** Conjecture 7.7 is stated in the arXiv preprint `arXiv:2610.17046v1` of N. Banić and N. Elezović (posted 2026-10-12, v1 only, no journal reference; not peer reviewed). Part 5 of the same series (`arXiv:2611.14735v1`, Remark 3.11) still lists the closed form as unproved. The proof in this repository is also not peer reviewed.

**Tiers.** "Kernel-checked" means the Lean 4.35.0 kernel accepted the proof. The 10 targets of `Challenge.lean` and the declarations they depend on are also replayed in CI by `lake comparator --paranoid`, which makes six checker runs: the Lean kernel in paranoid and default mode, `lean4lean`, `nanoda`, `con-leche`, and `con-ron` (two of the six runs are the Lean kernel). Separately, `NonVacuity.lean` is independently replayed in CI via `lake env leanchecker MultinomialTVConjecture.NonVacuity`.

## Claim Status Table

| ID | Claim | Verification Tier | Lean / Code Evidence | What Would Prove Us Wrong |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **C1** | For every $L \in \mathbb{N}$, the combinatorial reduction `hAdj L` equals the exact multinomial expectation $\mathbb{E}[|X_2-X_1|\,|X_3-X_2|]$ under $\mathrm{Mult}(L; 1/3, 1/3, 1/3)$, and satisfies the exact 1D rational identities `hAdj_mod0`, `hAdj_mod1`, `hAdj_mod2`. | **Kernel-checked** + **Exact rational Python** | `MultinomialTV.hAdj_eq_nested_sum`, `hAdj_mod0`, `hAdj_mod1`, `hAdj_mod2`, `NonVacuity.hAdj_zero..five`; `tests/test_exact_and_properties.py` | Any integer $L \ge 0$ where the exact rational 2D multinomial sum disagrees with the 1D formulas, or any flaw in `hAdj_eq_nested_sum` / `Challenge.lean`. |
| **C2** | For $r \in \{0,1,2\}$, $\lim_{q \to \infty} (3q+r)\bigl(h_{\mathrm{adj}}(3q+r) - c_L(3q+r) - a_*\bigr) = b_r$, with $b_0 = \frac{32\sqrt{3}}{81\pi}$ and $b_1 = b_2 = -\frac{22\sqrt{3}}{81\pi}$, matching $b_r = d_0 + \frac{4\sqrt{3}}{9\pi}\cos\!\left(\frac{2\pi r}{3}\right)$, **and** the quantitative $O(L^{-2})$ remainder bound $\exists C \ge 0,\;\forall L \ge 1,\;|h_{\mathrm{adj}}(L) - c_L L - a_* - b_{L\bmod 3}/L| \le C/L^2$ holds (full Lemma 7.3). | **Kernel-checked** (comparator targets 1–3 & 9) + **80-digit numerical (`mpmath`)** | `MultinomialTV.tendsto_hAdj_mod0..2`, `lemma_7_3_O_inv_sq`, `bRes_zero..two`, `bRes_cosine_formula`; `Challenge.lean`/`Solution.lean` (`target_lemma_7_3_O_inv_sq`); `scripts/verify_conjecture.py` | Any $r \in \{0,1,2\}$ for which Richardson extrapolation of exact $h_{\mathrm{adj}}(3q+r)$ converges to a different limit or exhibits slower than $O(L^{-2})$ remainder decay, or any mismatch between `Challenge.lean` and Banić & Elezović (2026) eq. (7.3) / Lemma 7.3. |
| **C3** | **Conjecture 7.7** (`conj:atriangle`, `arXiv:2610.17046v1`): $d_0 = -\frac{4\sqrt{3}}{81\pi}$, $a_\triangle = \frac{1}{32} - \frac{4\sqrt{3}}{243}$, and $\gamma_2 = -\frac{1}{32\pi} - \frac{8\sqrt{3}}{243\pi}$. | **Kernel-checked** (comparator target 4) + **Non-vacuity & adversarial checks** + **80-digit numerical** | `MultinomialTV.conjecture_7_7`, `conjecture_7_7_d0`, `conjecture_7_7_aTriangle`, `conjecture_7_7_gamma2`, `NonVacuity.adversarial_*`; `Solution.lean` | A valid counterexample showing $a_\triangle \ne \frac{1}{32} - \frac{4\sqrt{3}}{243}$, a non-standard axiom in `VerifyAxioms.lean`, a failure of any of the six comparator checker runs, or a statement-fidelity mismatch with Banić & Elezović's definitions. |
| **C4** | With $a_\triangle$ and $b_r$ as proved, the Banić–Elezović combinations of $p_1, q_1, r_1$ equal the printed closed forms for $\gamma(n)$ and $\gamma_c(n)$ (for every real $n \ne 0$) and for $\gamma(3; N)$ (both rearranged in target 7 and in the literal Part 2 §7.2 form `2 p_1(3) + 2 [b_{N mod 3} - 7/(96π)]` with `q_1(3) - d_0 = -7/(96π)` in target 10) and $\gamma(4; N)$ (for all $N \in \mathbb{N}$). These are identities between real expressions; Lean defines no random variable or variance. In target 8, $(-1)^N/(2\pi)$ appears unchanged on both sides. That these expressions are the $N^{-2}$ variance coefficients is Theorem 7.6, Lemmas 7.2 and 7.5, §7.2 and §8 of Part 2 (`arXiv:2610.17046v1`) and Theorem 3.10 of Part 5 (`arXiv:2611.14735v1`), cited and not formalized (while the Lemma 7.3 $O(\ell^{-2})$ remainder itself IS proved in Lean as Claim **C2**). The source states the general formulas for integer $n \ge 5$, with $n = 3, 4$ treated separately. | **Kernel-checked algebraic identity** (comparator targets 5–8 & 10); upstream Theorem 7.6 / §7.2 / §8 / Theorem 3.10 are **External literature** | `MultinomialTV.gamma_closed_form`, `gamma_cyclic_closed_form`, `gamma3_closed_form`, `gamma3_source_form`, `gamma4_closed_form`, `NonVacuity.gamma_*_witness_*`; `Solution.lean` | Either (a) an algebraic error in substituting $a_\triangle$ into Theorem 7.6 / §7.2 / §8 / Theorem 3.10 (excluded if the Lean proof is sound), or (b) an error in Banić & Elezović's upstream theorems, which are NOT formalized here. |
| **C5** | Zero `sorry`, `admit`, custom `axiom`, `native_decide`, `decide +native`, `unsafe`, `implemented_by`, `@[extern]`, or `@[nolint]` suppressions appear anywhere in `lean/MultinomialTVConjecture/` or `lean/Solution.lean`, and all 896 theorem constants (191 author-written theorems and lemmas, 705 compiler-generated auxiliaries) plus all 65 project definitions depend only on `[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]`. | **Automated CI + comparator (six checker runs + live negative tamper check) + `leanchecker`** | `lean/VerifyAxioms.lean`, `scripts/check_lean_tokens.py`, `results/lean-axioms-all.log`, `results/comparator-paranoid.log`, `scripts/check_readme_axioms.py`, `.github/workflows/lean-verify.yml` | Any forbidden token or `@[nolint]` found by `scripts/check_lean_tokens.py`, any theorem or definition outside the 3-axiom allowlist, or any failure of `lake comparator --config comparator.json --paranoid` or `leanchecker`. |
| **C6** | All 16 identifiers in `paper/refs.bib` (4 arXiv IDs, 12 DOIs, covering 15 of the 16 entries; one textbook has no identifier) resolve HTTP 200, pass live title/author/`primaryClass` metadata matching against `paper/refs.bib`, and have 0 retractions across Crossref `updated-by`, `update-to`, and `relation` (including `arXiv:2610.13366`, `arXiv:2610.17046v1`, `arXiv:2611.14735v1`). `check_citations.py` does not check cited theorem numbers; those are checked by hand against the live arXiv sources, and five shifted Part 5 locators from `v2.3.0` were fixed in `v2.4.0`/`v2.5.0` (see [ERRATA.md](ERRATA.md)). | **Automated citation audit + live Crossref JSON / arXiv Atom XML check** | `scripts/check_citations.py`, `results/citation-audit.json`, `tests/test_repo_integrity.py` | Any DOI or arXiv ID resolving to HTTP 404, a wrong title/author/`primaryClass`, a retracted Crossref record (`updated-by`/`update-to`/`relation`), or a cited theorem, remark, or section number that does not match the source. |

## Explicit Falsification Protocol (What Would Prove Us Wrong)

To refute our core mathematical result (**C3**), a critic only needs to produce **any one** of the following:
1. **A definition-fidelity counterexample:** Show that `Challenge.hAdj`, `Challenge.cL`, `Challenge.aStar`, `Challenge.bRes`, `Challenge.aTriangle`, or `Challenge.gamma2` in [lean/Challenge.lean](lean/Challenge.lean) fails to match the literal mathematical definitions in Banić & Elezović (`arXiv:2610.17046v1`, Section 7.2).
2. **A kernel soundness breach:** Demonstrate that `lean/VerifyAxioms.lean` or `lake comparator --config comparator.json --paranoid` fails on a clean install of Lean 4.35.0, or depends on any axiom outside `[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]`.
3. **A numerical contradiction:** Produce a high-precision exact evaluation of $h_{\mathrm{adj}}(L)$ at large $L$ whose asymptotic $1/L$ residue limits disagree with $b_0 = \frac{32\sqrt{3}}{81\pi}$ or $b_1 = b_2 = -\frac{22\sqrt{3}}{81\pi}$ beyond the $O(L^{-2})$ error bound.
4. **An upstream retraction:** If Banić & Elezović retract or amend Theorem 7.6 (Part 2) or Theorem 3.10 (Part 5), Claim **C4** would need re-derivation (while Claims **C1–C3** regarding $h_{\mathrm{adj}}(L)$, $b_r$, quantitative $O(L^{-2})$ Lemma 7.3, $d_0$, $a_\triangle$, and $\gamma_2$ would remain mathematically valid standalone theorems).

Any verified refutation will be credited prominently in [ERRATA.md](ERRATA.md) and [REPLICATION.md](REPLICATION.md).

=== LIMITATIONS.md ===

# Limitations, Verification Boundaries & Real-vs-Metaphor (`LIMITATIONS.md`)

This document states explicitly what our Lean 4 formalization and numerical verification **do** establish, what they **do not** establish, and where literal mathematical claims stop.

## 1. Formal Verification Boundary (What Lean Checks vs. What Lies Outside)

| Layer | Inside Lean 4 (kernel-checked) | Outside Lean 4 (Cited / Scripted / Human-Audited) |
|---|---|---|
| **Combinatorial definition & reduction** | `hAdj L` equals exact nested multinomial sum (`hAdj_eq_nested_sum`); exact 1D identities for `L = 3q, 3q+1, 3q+2`. | Equivalence between the discrete sum and probabilistic measure-space notation `E[|X_2 - X_1||X_3 - X_2|]` is standard finite-support probability (audited in [docs/statement-fidelity.md](docs/statement-fidelity.md)). |
| **Conjecture 7.7 (`b_0, b_1, b_2, d_0, a_△, γ_2`) & Lemma 7.3 $O(L^{-2})$ remainder** | Kernel-checked by Lean 4.35.0 from Mathlib using only the three standard axioms, including the quantitative $O(L^{-2})$ remainder bound `lemma_7_3_O_inv_sq` (Target 9). All 10 targets of `Challenge.lean` and their dependencies are replayed in CI by six comparator checker runs (the Lean kernel in paranoid and default mode, `lean4lean`, `nanoda`, `con-leche`, `con-ron`), and `NonVacuity.lean` is independently replayed via `lake env leanchecker MultinomialTVConjecture.NonVacuity`. | Independent human line-by-line fidelity review of `Challenge.lean` against `arXiv:2610.17046v1` is **OPEN** (`human_line_by_line_review_recorded: false` in `formalization.yaml`). The source is an unrefereed arXiv v1 preprint. |
| **Linear, cyclic & small-bin formulas `γ(n)`, `γ_c(n)`, `γ(3;N)`, `γ(4;N)`** | Exact algebraic/trigonometric identities after substituting `aTriangle` and `bRes` (`gamma_closed_form`, `gamma_cyclic_closed_form`, `gamma3_closed_form`, `gamma3_source_form`, `gamma4_closed_form`). Lean defines no random variable or variance; `n` is any nonzero real, while the source treats integer `n ≥ 5` and `n = 3, 4` separately. Target 10 (`target_gamma3_source_form`) states the literal Part 2 §7.2 `n = 3` source expression and proves its equivalence `q_1(3) - d_0 = -7/(96π)` with Target 7; in Target 8 the term `(−1)^N/(2π)` is carried unchanged on both sides, not derived. | That these expressions are the `N^{-2}` variance coefficients is Theorem 7.6, Lemmas 7.2 and 7.5, §7.2 and §8 of Banić & Elezović Part 2 (`arXiv:2610.17046v1`) and Theorem 3.10 of Part 5 (`arXiv:2611.14735v1`): **cited external results from unrefereed preprints, NOT proved in Lean**. (Note: Part 2 Lemma 7.3's $O(\ell^{-2})$ remainder itself IS formally proved in Lean as `lemma_7_3_O_inv_sq`.) |
| **Numerical verification (`scripts/verify_conjecture.py`)** | Exact rational `hAdj 0..5` proved in `NonVacuity.lean`. | Exact rational checks for $L=3..45$ (43 values) and 80-digit `mpmath` checks up to $q=3{,}000$ ($L=9{,}001$; 28-point Neville–Richardson error $< 3\times 10^{-55}$) run in Python (`fractions` + `mpmath`), outside the Lean kernel. |
| **Manuscript & prose (`paper/main.tex`)** | Theorem statements correspond 1-to-1 to Lean declarations (`docs/statement-fidelity.md`, `blueprint/src/content.tex`). | LaTeX typesetting, historical context, and prose exposition are human/AI-authored and NOT checked by a proof assistant. All manuscript locator and scope corrections identified in the `2026-11-26` statement audit of `v2.3.0` and subsequent rounds are resolved through `v2.7.0` (see [ERRATA.md](ERRATA.md)). |

## 2. Specific Technical & Process Limitations

1. **No external peer review yet:** The manuscript is an independent research preprint. It has NOT yet undergone journal peer review, arXiv moderation, or Palomar Registry acceptance. The source of the conjecture, `arXiv:2610.17046v1`, is itself an arXiv v1 preprint (posted 2026-10-12) with no journal reference.
2. **Human line-by-line fidelity audit & external operator replication are open:** `Challenge.lean` is 164 lines of Mathlib-only Lean 4 (with a Lean 4.35 `module` header, 10 targets). `NonVacuity.lean` proves 22 small-$L$, small-$n$, and adversarial checks: **6** of them (`hAdj 0..5`) test the definition `hAdj` directly, and the other **16** are corollaries/refutations of the proved closed forms covering all 10 targets (including `adversarial_lemma_7_3_zero_const_false` and `gamma3_source_form_witness_N1`, so they verify non-degeneracy and witness coverage but cannot by themselves detect a wrong specification). No independent third-party mathematician has yet signed off line-by-line on `docs/statement-fidelity.md` or logged an external clean-room replication (`B44: partial` in `repo.yaml`).
3. **Lean 4.35.0 `module` system & Palomar readiness:** All 10 Lean source files carry Lean 4.35.0 `module` headers (`public import` + `@[expose] public section`) and compile with **zero `@[nolint]` suppressions** and no compiler or Mathlib style-linter warnings except the 10 intentional `declaration uses sorry` warnings of the statement-only `Challenge.lean` (`weak.linter.mathlibStandardSet = true`), satisfying Palomar Registry's file-level `module` and size rules (`Challenge.lean` 164 lines / ~7.8 KiB, longest file 3,572 lines).
4. **Windows vs. Linux sandbox for `lake comparator`:** On Linux (`ubuntu-24.04` CI), `lake comparator --config comparator.json --paranoid` makes all six checker runs (`Lean paranoid`, `lean4lean`, `nanoda`, `con-leche`, `con-ron`, `Lean default`) inside a `bubblewrap` namespace sandbox. Upstream Lean 4.35.0 `lake comparator` requires Linux `bubblewrap` and does not run directly on native Windows; on Windows, 5 of the 6 bundled checkers (`lean 4.35.0`, `leanchecker-paranoid`, `nanoda_bin`, `con-leche`, `con-ron`) can be invoked directly on `leanexport` output while the full comparator run (including `lean4lean`) needs Linux containers or Ubuntu 24.04 CI.
5. **AI-assisted provenance:** Mathematical exploration, Lean 4 proof engineering, Python test scaffolding, and LaTeX drafting were conducted with AI assistance under Alexander S. Donahue's direction (see `formalization.yaml` and the paragraph *"AI assistance, CRediT authorship, conflicts of interest, and errata policy"* in `paper/main.tex`). Epistemic warrant rests strictly on the reproducible Lean kernel check, the CI comparator replay, and the independent exact calculations, never on author or model authority.
6. **Historical 2026-11-26 statement audit note:** In the external statement audit of commit `0a69443` (`v2.3.0`), `lake exe cache get` failed on the auditor's machine (local Mathlib cache error), so that audit relied on CI run `45832736228` and file-by-file elaboration rather than a local comparator run. From `v2.5.0` onward, the full Lean build and all six comparator checker runs execute cleanly on public GitHub Actions CI.
7. **Elaboration smoke test & negative comparator test vs. kernel-checked refutation:** The mathematical refutations of $a_\triangle = 1/32$ and of a zero-constant $O(L^{-2})$ remainder are the proved theorems `adversarial_aTriangle_ne_one_div_32` and `adversarial_lemma_7_3_zero_const_false` in `NonVacuity.lean`. Separately, CI runs (a) a standalone elaboration smoke test (`/tmp/neg_smoke_test.lean` importing `MultinomialTVConjecture.Main` and asserting `unsolved goals` on `aTriangle = 1 / 32`), and (b) a live negative `lake comparator --paranoid` tamper test (injecting `sorry` into a subshell-guarded copy of `Solution.lean` Target 4 and asserting non-zero rejection). Earlier versions (`v2.1.0`–`v2.3.0`) overclaimed the smoke test as a standalone proof of falsity (corrected in `v2.5.0`), and `v2.5.0`–`v2.6.0` inaccurately described it as copying `Main.lean` (`F-74`, fixed in `v2.7.0`).
8. **Export-control self-screen (EAR 15 CFR 734.8 / ITAR 22 CFR 120):** This repository contains solely published fundamental mathematical research in probability and statistics (asymptotic variance of discrete total variation under the uniform multinomial law) with zero cryptographic, defense, or dual-use technical data or software.

## 3. Real vs. Metaphor

- Every mathematical term in this repository (`multinomial distribution`, `discrete total variation`, `Euler–Maclaurin summation`, `Stirling expansion`, `asymptotic variance`, `residue class`) is used strictly in its **literal, standard mathematical definition**—there are no physical, biological, or heuristic metaphors.
- The axiom-audit block in `README.md` is an excerpt (25 of the 59 `depends on axioms` lines and the summary line). Re-running `lake env lean VerifyAxioms.lean` against pre-built `.olean` caches prints the full output; a cold build without Mathlib's `lake exe cache get` takes substantially longer (~2–5 minutes with cache, >30 minutes compiling Mathlib from source).
- **"Six checker runs"** means the six passes of `lake comparator --paranoid` over `Challenge.lean` and `Solution.lean`: the Lean 4.35.0 kernel in paranoid and default mode, `lean4lean`, `nanoda 0.4.19`, `con-leche`, and `con-ron`. Two of the six are the Lean kernel, and whether `con-leche` and `con-ron` are separate implementations has not been checked here. The replay does **not** remove the need to inspect `Challenge.lean` itself for statement fidelity against Banić & Elezović (2026).

---

=== REPLICATION.md ===

# Replication Protocol (`REPLICATION.md`)

Any independent researcher can reproduce every formal theorem, comparator replay (six checker runs), exact rational calculation, 80-digit numerical check, Blueprint graph, and PDF build from a clean clone without trusting the author or any pre-computed log.

## 1. Prerequisites

| Tool | Pinned Version | Install |
|---|---|---|
| **Git** | Any modern 2.x | https://git-scm.com |
| **elan / Lean 4** | `leanprover/lean4:v4.35.0` (auto-selected by `lean/lean-toolchain`) | https://github.com/leanprover/elan |
| **Python** | `3.12+` (`requirements.txt` pinned) | https://www.python.org |
| **bubblewrap** *(Linux only, for sandboxed `lake comparator`)* | distro package | `sudo apt-get install -y bubblewrap` |
| **Tectonic** *(optional, for compiling `paper/main.tex`)* | `0.17.0` | https://tectonic-typesetting.github.io |
| **just** *(optional convenience runner)* | `1.x` | https://just.systems |

## 2. Clean-Clone End-to-End Replication Steps

```bash
# 1. Clone and install pinned Python deps
git clone https://github.com/0thernes/multinomial-tv-conjecture.git
cd multinomial-tv-conjecture
python3 -m pip install -r requirements.txt

# 2. Fetch prebuilt Mathlib cache & compile all Lean libraries + isolated Challenge/Solution
cd lean
lake exe cache get
lake build MultinomialTVConjecture Challenge Solution VerifyAxioms

# 3. Run exhaustive axiom audit (verify ALL_THEOREMS_AXIOM_AUDIT_PASS & strict 3-axiom allowlist) and standalone NonVacuity kernel replay
lake env lean VerifyAxioms.lean
lake env leanchecker MultinomialTVConjecture.NonVacuity

# 4. Run comparator (six checker runs; Linux with bubblewrap, or WSL2/Docker on Windows/macOS)
lake comparator --config comparator.json --paranoid

# 5. Return to repo root and run Python exact + 80-digit verifier, full test ladder, citations, blueprint, site
cd ..
python3 scripts/verify_conjecture.py
python3 -m pytest -v tests/
python3 scripts/check_citations.py
python3 scripts/check_readme_axioms.py --require-exhaustive
python3 scripts/build_blueprint.py
python3 scripts/build_site.py
bash scripts/audit-repo.sh .
```

## 3. Expected Pass Criteria

1. `lake env lean VerifyAxioms.lean` exits `0`, prints `ALL_THEOREMS_AXIOM_AUDIT_PASS`, and shows every theorem depending on a subset of `[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]`.
2. `lake comparator --config comparator.json --paranoid` exits `0` across all six checker runs (`Lean paranoid`, `lean4lean`, `nanoda`, `con-leche`, `con-ron`, `Lean default`; two of the six runs are the Lean kernel).
3. `python3 scripts/verify_conjecture.py` exits `0` with `PASS: Exact rational equality verified for all 43 values L = 3..45 (0/1 error)` and `PASS: All 6 constants match closed forms to > 40 decimal digits!` (actual Richardson errors $< 3\times 10^{-55}$).
4. `python3 -m pytest -v tests/` passes 100% of exact, property-based (`hypothesis`), negative, regression, golden, differential, metamorphic, numeric stability, mutation, and repo-integrity tests.
5. `python3 scripts/check_readme_axioms.py --require-exhaustive` confirms `README.md`'s 25-line excerpt and exact theorem count match `results/lean-axioms-all.log`.

## 4. Replication Log

See [ERRATA.md](ERRATA.md).

## 2026-11-26 Statement Audit Record (100% Closed in `v2.5.0`)

An independent statement audit of commit `0a69443` (`v2.3.0`) was run on 2026-11-26. Audit log: <https://github.com/0thernes/0thernes-research-archive/blob/main/docs/reviews/2026-11-26-statement-audit.md>. It confirmed that the Lean statement of Conjecture 7.7 matches the source clause by clause and that no earlier proof was found, while identifying errors of citation, scope, and wording (none of which affected any Lean theorem proof). Every item below—including all manuscript, metadata, Lean docstring, and CI items originally deferred after `0a69443`—is **RESOLVED in `v2.5.0`**:

| Category | What Was Wrong in `v2.3.0` (`0a69443`) | Resolution in `v2.5.0` |
|---|---|---|
| **Part 5 locators** (`paper/main.tex`, docs, `formalization.yaml`, `blueprint/`, Lean docstrings) | Cited `Theorem 5.2`, `Proposition 6.2`, and `Remarks 5.3, 5.5, 6.3` of `arXiv:2611.14735v1`. | Corrected everywhere to **`Theorem 3.10`**, **`Proposition 4.2`**, and **`Remarks 3.11, 3.13, and 4.3`**, and fixed `primaryClass = {math.PR}` for Parts 1 & 2 (`E-2026-015`). |
| **Part 2 locator** (`docs/statement-fidelity.md` SF-5, `Main.lean`) | Located Theorem 7.6 at `p. 35`. | Corrected to printed **`pp. 59–60`** (Theorem 7.6 on p. 59, Conjecture 7.7 on p. 60). |
| **Source status** (`README.md`, `CLAIMS.md`, `LIMITATIONS.md`, `paper/main.tex`, `docs/`, `formalization.yaml`) | Source described without noting its preprint status. | Explicitly states that `arXiv:2610.17046v1` (posted 2026-10-12) and `arXiv:2611.14735v1` are **unrefereed arXiv v1 preprints** with no journal reference, and that this repository is also not peer reviewed. |
| **Corollary 1.2 & Lemma 7.3 scope** (`paper/main.tex`, `README.md`, `CLAIMS.md`, `LIMITATIONS.md`, `Challenge.lean`, `Solution.lean`, `Main.lean`, `ROADMAP.md`) | Called $\gamma$ formulas `"unconditional"` consequences verified in Lean, and did not prove the $O(\ell^{-2})$ remainder of Part 2 Lemma 7.3. | (1) Formally proved the complete quantitative $O(\ell^{-2})$ remainder of Lemma 7.3 in Lean (`lemma_7_3_O_inv_sq`, Target 9); (2) narrowed Corollary 1.2 and Targets 5–8 everywhere (including `paper/main.tex` abstract, Corollary 1.2, Section 7, and Lean docstrings) to **algebraic identities** removing the sole conjectural input while explicitly stating that Lean defines no random variable or variance and that upstream Part 2 Theorem 7.6 / Lemmas 7.2 & 7.5 / §7.2 / §8 and Part 5 Theorem 3.10 remain cited, unformalized theorems. |
| **Author theorems vs. compiler constants** (`paper/main.tex`, `README.md`, `CLAIMS.md`, `docs/verification.md`, `formalization.yaml`, `scripts/build_site.py`, `scripts/generate_social_preview.py`) | Called total `Lean.collectAxioms` count `"named and module-private theorems"`. | Reports both exact counts everywhere: **187 author-written theorems and lemmas** and **892 audited theorem constants** (187 author-written + 705 compiler-generated auxiliaries). |
| **Six checker runs vs. "six independent kernels"** (every active doc, `paper/main.tex`, `CITATION.cff`, `formalization.yaml`, `blueprint/`, `AGENTS.md`, `REPLICATION.md`, `SUPPORT.md`, `llms.txt`, `justfile`, `repo.yaml`, `scripts/`, `docs/media/social-preview.svg`) | Claimed `"six independent kernels"` (counting `Lean paranoid` and `Lean default` separately). | Standardized everywhere to **six checker runs** of `lake comparator --paranoid` (explicitly noting that two of the six runs are the Lean kernel in paranoid and default mode, and that `NonVacuity.lean` is not replayed; historical `v2.0.0`–`v2.4.0` entries in `CHANGELOG.md`, `docs/run-log.md`, and `docs/reviews/red-team-2026-11-25.md` are kept as dated records with correction banners). |
| **CI negative check & adversarial refutation** (`.github/workflows/lean-verify.yml`, `scripts/dev.sh`, `paper/main.tex`, `README.md`, `LIMITATIONS.md`, `docs/verification.md`, `docs/threat-model.md`, `ROADMAP.md`) | Cited a CI step passing on any non-zero exit as a `"live negative Lean kernel rejection check"`. | Clarified everywhere that the true mathematical refutation of $a_\triangle = 1/32$ is the proved theorem `adversarial_aTriangle_ne_one_div_32` in `NonVacuity.lean`; upgraded the CI step to mutate a constant in a copy of `Main.lean` and explicitly assert `unsolved goals` as an elaboration smoke test. |
| **Compiler warnings, README excerpt, Targets 7–8, NonVacuity counts, citation script scope & tag `v2.3.0`** (`paper/main.tex`, `README.md`, `LIMITATIONS.md`, `CLAIMS.md`, `docs/`, `Challenge.lean`, `MultinomialTVConjecture.lean`, `VerifyAxioms.lean`) | Stated `"0 warnings"` for builds including `Challenge.lean`; called README block `"verbatim output"`; called Targets 5–8 `"verbatim"`; presented all 20 `NonVacuity` theorems as definition checks; overstated citation check scope; mismatched `MultinomialTVConjecture.lean` (`18`→`20`) and `VerifyAxioms.lean` comments; tag `v2.3.0` (`a1d84d7`) differed from archive commit `0a69443`. | Fixed every single item in `v2.5.0`: explicitly excludes the 9 intentional `sorry` warnings of statement-only `Challenge.lean`; labels the README block an **excerpt (23 of 55 `depends on axioms` lines + summary)**; documents Target 7 rearrangement & Target 8 `(-1)^N/(2\pi)` passthrough; splits NonVacuity into **6 direct `hAdj 0..5` definition checks + 14 closed-form corollaries/refutations**; states `16 identifiers over 15 of 16 entries` and notes `check_citations.py` does not verify theorem numbers; fixed comments in `MultinomialTVConjecture.lean` (`20`) and `VerifyAxioms.lean` (`26` primary); and cut fresh immutable release tag **`v2.5.0`** (never moving historical tags `v2.3.0` or `v2.4.0`). |

**Mathematical status:** Zero mathematical errors have been discovered in any Lean theorem statement or proof of `v1.0.0`–`v2.7.0`; all original Lean 4 theorems remain unchanged in mathematical content, are strengthened by the machine-checked quantitative $O(\ell^{-2})$ Lemma 7.3 remainder theorem (`lemma_7_3_O_inv_sq`, Target 9), literal Part 2 §7.2 $n = 3$ bridge (`gamma3_source_form`, Target 10), and non-degeneracy refutation (`adversarial_lemma_7_3_zero_const_false`), have zero `@[nolint]` suppressions, and pass all six comparator checker runs.

## Withdrawal Policy

If a mathematical flaw or statement-fidelity defect is ever discovered that invalidates a core claim in `CLAIMS.md`, the author commits to logging it here within 72 hours, tagging a corrected release, and posting an explicit retraction/erratum notice on GitHub Releases and any external preprint server where the manuscript has been deposited.

# Statement-Fidelity Audit Table (`docs/statement-fidelity.md`)

Maps every headline Lean 4.35.0 declaration in `MultinomialTV` and `Challenge.lean` to its informal mathematical statement and literature anchor so an independent mathematician can inspect for definition drift, weakened hypotheses, or vacuity without reading proof internals.

> **Human review status:** Mechanical compilation (0 `@[nolint]`), 22 non-vacuity/adversarial witnesses (`NonVacuity.lean`, independently replayed via `lake env leanchecker MultinomialTVConjecture.NonVacuity`), and `lake comparator --paranoid` (10 targets, six checker runs: the Lean kernel in paranoid and default mode, `lean4lean`, `nanoda`, `con-leche`, `con-ron`, plus live negative `sorry`-tamper rejection) are automated and green in CI. **6** of the 22 witnesses (`hAdj 0..5`) test the definition `hAdj` directly; the other **16** are corollaries/refutations of the proved closed forms covering all 10 targets (including `adversarial_lemma_7_3_zero_const_false` and `gamma3_source_form_witness_N1`). **Independent human line-by-line fidelity sign-off remains OPEN** (`human_line_by_line_review_recorded: false` in `formalization.yaml`).

| ID | Lean Declaration | Informal Mathematical Statement | Literature Anchor | Fidelity Notes & Non-Vacuity | Human Sign-Off |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **SF-1** | `MultinomialTV.hAdj_eq_nested_sum` / `Challenge.hAdj` | $h_{\mathrm{adj}}(L) = 3^{-L} \sum_{x_1=0}^{L} \sum_{x_2=0}^{L-x_1} \frac{L!}{x_1! x_2! (L-x_1-x_2)!} |x_2-x_1|\,|L-x_1-x_2-x_2| = \mathbb{E}[|X_2-X_1|\,|X_3-X_2|]$ under $\mathrm{Mult}(L; \frac13, \frac13, \frac13)$. | Banić & Elezović Part 2 (`arXiv:2610.17046v1`, Sec. 7.2) | `Challenge.lean` defines `hAdj` directly as the verbatim nested sum using only Mathlib; `NonVacuity.lean` proves exact values $h_{\mathrm{adj}}(0)=0, h_{\mathrm{adj}}(1)=\frac13, h_{\mathrm{adj}}(2)=\frac23, h_{\mathrm{adj}}(3)=\frac{13}{9}, h_{\mathrm{adj}}(4)=\frac{140}{81}, h_{\mathrm{adj}}(5)=\frac{545}{243}$. | Open |
| **SF-2** | `MultinomialTV.hAdj_mod0`, `hAdj_mod1`, `hAdj_mod2` | Exact 1D closed reductions of $h_{\mathrm{adj}}(3q+r)$ ($r \in \{0,1,2\}$) in terms of central trinomial mass $p_{3q}(q)$ and three 1D weighted binomial/trinomial sums `sumA`, `sumB`, `sumC`. | Manuscript Sec. 2 (Theorem 2.3, eqs. (2.11)–(2.13)) | Verified identically in exact rational Python `Fraction` arithmetic for $L = 3..45$ (43 values, 0/1 discrepancy) in `scripts/verify_conjecture.py` and `tests/test_exact_and_properties.py`. | Open |

| **SF-4** | `MultinomialTV.conjecture_7_7`, `conjecture_7_7_d0`, `conjecture_7_7_aTriangle`, `conjecture_7_7_gamma2`, `bRes_cosine_formula` / `Challenge.target_conjecture_7_7` | $d_0 = -\frac{4\sqrt{3}}{81\pi}$, $a_\triangle = \frac{1}{32} - \frac{4\sqrt{3}}{243}$, $\gamma_2 = -\frac{1}{32\pi} - \frac{8\sqrt{3}}{243\pi}$, and $b_r = d_0 + \frac{4\sqrt{3}}{9\pi}\cos(\frac{2\pi r}{3})$ for $r \in \{0,1,2\}$. | **Banić & Elezović Part 2 (`arXiv:2610.17046v1`, Conjecture 7.7 / `conj:atriangle`, Def. 7.4, Thm 7.6, printed pp. 59–60)** | `Challenge.lean` defines `bRes`, `d0`, `aTriangle`, `gamma2` verbatim from `arXiv:2610.17046v1` eq. (7.3) & Thm 7.6; `NonVacuity` proves strict positivity `0 < aTriangle < 1/32` and refutes false constants `aTriangle ≠ 1/32`, `d0 ≠ 0`. Wording note: the source first defines $d_0$ as the origin-saddle constant and shows it equals the residue mean by Lemma 7.3; `Challenge.lean` defines `d0` as the residue mean. | Open |
| **SF-5** | `MultinomialTV.gamma_closed_form` / `Challenge.target_gamma_closed_form` | Substituting $a_\triangle = \frac{1}{32} - \frac{4\sqrt{3}}{243}$ into $(n-1)p_1 + 2(n-2)q_1 + (n-2)(n-3)r_1$ yields $\gamma(n) = -\frac{n(n+1)}{32\pi} - \frac{8\sqrt{3}\,n(n-2)}{243\pi} + \frac{n-1}{8\pi n}$ for all real $n \ne 0$ (specializing to integer $n \ge 5$). | Banić & Elezović Part 2 (`arXiv:2610.17046v1`, Thm 7.6, printed p. 59) | **Boundary caveat:** Lean proves the exact algebraic identity over real $n \ne 0$ (witnessed at $n=5$ in `gamma_closed_form_witness_n5`). Lean defines no random variable or variance; upstream Theorem 7.6 (that this expression is the $N^{-2}$ variance coefficient for integer $n \ge 5$) is cited externally and NOT formalized in Lean. | Open |
| **SF-6** | `MultinomialTV.gamma_cyclic_closed_form` / `Challenge.target_gamma_cyclic_closed_form` | Substituting $a_\triangle = \frac{1}{32} - \frac{4\sqrt{3}}{243}$ into $n p_1 + 2n q_1 + n(n-3)r_1$ yields $\gamma_c(n) = -\frac{n(n+4)}{32\pi} - \frac{8\sqrt{3}\,n^2}{243\pi}$ for all real $n \ne 0$ (specializing to integer $n \ge 5$). | Banić & Elezović Part 5 (`arXiv:2611.14735v1`, Thm 3.10) | **Boundary caveat:** Lean proves the exact algebraic identity over real $n \ne 0$ (witnessed at $n=5$ in `gamma_cyclic_closed_form_witness_n5`). Lean defines no random variable or variance; upstream Theorem 3.10 of Part 5 is cited externally and NOT formalized in Lean. | Open |
| **SF-7** | `MultinomialTV.gamma3_closed_form`, `gamma3_source_form`, `gamma4_closed_form` / `Challenge.target_gamma3_closed_form`, `target_gamma3_source_form`, `target_gamma4_closed_form` | Substituting $a_\triangle$ and $b_{N\bmod 3}$ yields $\gamma(3; N) = 2p_1(3) + 2[b_{N\bmod 3} - \frac{7}{96\pi}] = -\frac{7}{24\pi} - \frac{8\sqrt{3}}{81\pi} + \frac{8\sqrt{3}}{9\pi}\cos(\frac{2\pi N}{3})$ (with $q_1(3) - d_0 = -\frac{7}{96\pi}$) and $\gamma(4; N) = -\frac{17}{32\pi} - \frac{64\sqrt{3}}{243\pi} + \frac{(-1)^N}{2\pi}$ for all $N \in \mathbb{N}$. | Banić & Elezović Part 2 (`arXiv:2610.17046v1`, §7.2, §8); Manuscript Corollary 1.2(iii) | **Boundary caveat:** Lean proves all three exact algebraic/trigonometric identities (witnessed at $N=0$ in `gamma3/4_closed_form_witness_N0` and at non-zero residue $N=1$ in `gamma3_source_form_witness_N1`). Upstream §7.2 and §8 decompositions are cited externally and NOT formalized in Lean. Target 10 (`target_gamma3_source_form`) states the literal Part 2 §7.2 source expression $2p_1(3) + 2[b_{N\bmod 3} - \frac{7}{96\pi}]$ and formally proves the bridge equality $q_1(3) - d_0 = -\frac{7}{96\pi}$ linking it to Target 7. In Target 8 the term $\frac{(-1)^N}{2\pi}$ appears unchanged on both sides, so its dependence on $N$ is carried, not derived. | Open |

=== docs/architecture.md ===

# Proof & Verification Architecture (`docs/architecture.md`)

## Mathematical Proof Pipeline

The Lean 4 formalization proves Conjecture 7.7 and the quantitative $O(L^{-2})$ remainder of Lemma 7.3 of Banić & Elezović (`arXiv:2610.17046v1`, an unrefereed arXiv v1 preprint) through a five-stage reduction that replaces an intractable 2D triangular-lattice asymptotic expansion with three elementary 1D sums:

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A["Combinatorial.lean<br/>2D Simplex -> Exact 1D Sums (hAdj_mod0..2)"] --> E["Main.lean<br/>Poly Combination + tendsto_hAdj_mod0..2 + lemma_7_3_O_inv_sq"]
    B["StirlingRefined.lean<br/>Central Trinomial Expansion p3q_center_expansion"] --> E
    C["GaussianEulerMaclaurin.lean<br/>Odd Gaussian Sums (O(h^3) & O(h^4))"] --> D["LocalAsymptotics.lean<br/>1D Asymptotics tendsto_sumA..C & sumA..C_O_inv_sq"]
    B --> D
    D --> E
    E --> F["Conjecture 7.7 + Lemma 7.3 O(L^-2) + gamma algebraic identities"]
    F --> G["NonVacuity.lean<br/>22 Concrete & Adversarial Witnesses (leanchecker)"]
    F --> H["Solution.lean vs Challenge.lean<br/>lake comparator --paranoid, six checker runs (10 Targets)"]
```

## Module Breakdown

| Module | Role | Key Exports |
|---|---|---|
| `lean/MultinomialTVConjecture/Combinatorial.lean` | Exact simplex summation and algebraic identities eliminating the 2D sum | `hAdj`, `p3q`, `sumA`, `sumB`, `sumC`, `hAdj_mod0`, `hAdj_mod1`, `hAdj_mod2` |
| `lean/MultinomialTVConjecture/StirlingRefined.lean` | Quantitative Robbins-type Stirling remainder with $O(q^{-3})$ control | `p3q_center_expansion` |
| `lean/MultinomialTVConjecture/GaussianEulerMaclaurin.lean` | 3rd- and 4th-order Euler–Maclaurin approximations of odd-lattice Gaussian sums | `oddGauss_sum_approx`, `oddGauss_sum_approx_order4` |
| `lean/MultinomialTVConjecture/LocalAsymptotics.lean` | Local Gaussian/Laplace $o(q^{-1})$ limits and $O(q^{-2})$ remainder bounds for the three 1D sums (0 `@[nolint]`) | `tendsto_sumA..C`, `sumA_O_inv_sq`, `sumB_O_inv_sq`, `sumC_O_inv_sq` |
| `lean/MultinomialTVConjecture/Main.lean` | Exact nested-sum equivalence, residue limits `b_0, b_1, b_2`, quantitative $O(L^{-2})$ Lemma 7.3, Conjecture 7.7, and linear/cyclic/small-bin algebraic identities (incl. literal Part 2 §7.2 `gamma3_source_form`) | `hAdj_eq_nested_sum`, `tendsto_hAdj_mod0..2`, `lemma_7_3_O_inv_sq`, `conjecture_7_7`, `gamma_closed_form`, `gamma_cyclic_closed_form`, `gamma3_closed_form`, `gamma3_source_form`, `gamma4_closed_form` |
| `lean/MultinomialTVConjecture/NonVacuity.lean` | 6 direct definition checks (`hAdj 0..5`) + 16 sign, witness, and false-constant/non-degeneracy refutation corollaries covering all 10 targets (independently replayed via `leanchecker`) | `hAdj_zero..five`, `adversarial_*`, `gamma*_witness_*` |
| `lean/Challenge.lean` | 100% Mathlib-only target statements (164 lines, 10 intentional `sorry` stubs, zero proof-library imports) | `MultinomialTV.ComparatorTarget.target_*` |
| `lean/Solution.lean` | Sorry-free bridge proving `Challenge.lean` targets via `MultinomialTVConjecture.Main` | Same 10 declarations, replayed in six comparator checker runs |
| `lean/VerifyAxioms.lean` | Exhaustive `Lean.collectAxioms` metaprogram + 59 explicit `#print axioms` checks | Emits `ALL_THEOREMS_AXIOM_AUDIT_PASS` (`896` theorem constants [`191` author + `705` auxiliaries] + `65` definitions) |

## Independent Verification Layer

- **`scripts/verify_conjecture.py`**: Completely independent Python implementation computing exact rational `Fraction` values for $L=3..45$ (0/1 error) and 80-digit `mpmath` evaluations up to $q=3{,}000$ ($L=9{,}001$) with 28-point Neville–Richardson extrapolation matching all 6 constants to $>54$ decimal digits ($<3\times 10^{-55}$).
- **`tests/` & `scripts/run_mutation_audit.py`**: Automated `pytest` + `hypothesis` ladder testing exact identities, negative/adversarial bounds, regressions, golden snapshots, differential/oracle checks, metamorphic invariants, multi-precision stability, isolated AST source-code mutation auditing (`24/24` killed across 7 scripts), and repository metadata integrity.
- **`blueprint/` & `scripts/build_blueprint.py`**: Validates every `\lean{...}` tag in `blueprint/src/content.tex` against actual Lean declarations and emits a static SVG DAG + HTML page at `build/site/blueprint/`.

=== docs/verification.md ===

# Verification Stack (`docs/verification.md`)

This repository enforces defense-in-depth verification across **three independent layers**: formal Lean 4 kernel checking plus comparator replay, exact/arbitrary-precision independent computation with isolated code-mutation auditing, and continuous structural/bibliographic integrity checks.

## Layer 1: Lean 4.35.0 Kernel and Comparator Replay

1. **Strict Compiler Hygiene (`lean/lakefile.toml` & Palomar `module` headers):**
   - `autoImplicit = false`, `relaxedAutoImplicit = false`, and `weak.linter.mathlibStandardSet = true` (`weak.linter.style.longLine = false`) enforce Mathlib style hygiene and eliminate accidental free variables in theorem statements.
   - All 10 `.lean` files carry Lean 4.35.0 `module` headers (`public import` + `@[expose] public section`) and REUSE/SPDX Apache-2.0 headers, compiling with **zero `@[nolint]` suppressions** and no compiler or style-linter warnings except the 10 intentional `declaration uses sorry` warnings of the statement-only `Challenge.lean`.
   - Pinned toolchain `leanprover/lean4:v4.35.0` and pinned Mathlib4/Batteries lockfile (`lean/lake-manifest.json`).
2. **Forbidden-Token & Zero-`@[nolint]` Lexer (`scripts/check_lean_tokens.py`):**
   - Comment- and string-aware nested Lean lexer invoked identically from `.github/workflows/lean-verify.yml`, `scripts/dev.sh verify-lean`, and `tests/test_repo_integrity.py` scanning every `.lean` proof file in `lean/MultinomialTVConjecture/` and `lean/Solution.lean` for `sorry`, `admit`, `axiom` (including `public`/`private`/`protected`/`noncomputable`), `partial def`/`theorem`, `native_decide`, `decide +native`, `unsafe`, `implemented_by`, `@[extern]`, and `@[nolint]`, and asserting every file carries a `module` header. Zero hits required.
3. **Exhaustive Axiom Audit (`lean/VerifyAxioms.lean`):**
   - Runs `#print axioms` on all 59 exported declarations (27 primary + 22 `NonVacuity` + 10 `ComparatorTarget`) AND a Lean metaprogram (`import all` across all proof modules) iterating `Lean.collectAxioms` over **every** theorem constant (**896 in total**: **191** author-written theorems and lemmas and **705** compiler-generated auxiliaries such as `_proof_N` and `_simp_N`) **plus all 65 project definitions**, emitting `ALL_THEOREMS_AXIOM_AUDIT_PASS` only if every theorem and definition lies strictly within `[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]`.
   - `scripts/check_readme_axioms.py --require-exhaustive` verifies that every line of `README.md`'s `#print axioms` excerpt (25 of the 59 lines) and both theorem and definition counts match `results/lean-axioms-all.log`.
4. **Comparator (`lake comparator --config comparator.json --paranoid`):**
   - Compares isolated Mathlib-only `lean/Challenge.lean` (10 target stubs including `target_lemma_7_3_O_inv_sq` and literal Part 2 §7.2 `target_gamma3_source_form`, zero proof imports) against sorry-free `lean/Solution.lean` and replays all 10 targets and the declarations they depend on in **six checker runs** (names as printed in the CI log):
     1. Lean paranoid kernel
     2. `lean4lean` (v4.35.0, Lean-in-Lean kernel)
     3. `nanoda` (0.4.19, Rust kernel)
     4. `con-leche` (v4.35.0)
     5. `con-ron` (v4.35.0)
     6. Lean default kernel
   - Two of the six runs are the Lean kernel. CI additionally runs a **live negative `sorry`-tamper comparator test** (temporarily replacing Target 4 in `Solution.lean` with `sorry` inside a trap-restored subshell and asserting `lake comparator --paranoid` exits non-zero).
5. **Non-Vacuity & Adversarial Checks (`lean/MultinomialTVConjecture/NonVacuity.lean`):**
   - 22 theorems proving concrete exact rational values `hAdj 0..5`, strict sign/ordering bounds (`bRes 0 > 0`, `bRes 1 < 0`, `0 < aTriangle < 1/32`, `d0 < 0`, `gamma2 < 0`), 4 deliberate false-constant/non-degeneracy refutations (`aTriangle ≠ 1/32`, `d0 ≠ 0`, `¬(bRes 0 = bRes 1 ∧ bRes 1 = bRes 2)`, and `adversarial_lemma_7_3_zero_const_false` proving no $C=0$ suffices for Lemma 7.3), and concrete $n \in \{3, 4, 5\}$ / $N \in \{0, 1\}$ witnesses (including Target 10's `gamma3_source_form_witness_N1`). Only the **6** `hAdj 0..5` values test a definition directly; the other **16** are corollaries/refutations of the proved closed forms covering all 10 targets. Independently replayed in CI via `lake env leanchecker MultinomialTVConjecture.NonVacuity`.
6. **Batteries Linter (`lake exe runLinter MultinomialTVConjecture`):**
   - Runs report-only in CI and logs to `results/lean-linter.log`.

## Layer 2: Independent Exact Rational & 80-Digit Verification (`scripts/` & `tests/`)

| Test Category (Build Standard) | Implementation |
|---|---|
| **Exact rational oracle (`B12`)** | Exact `fractions.Fraction` 2D multinomial sum vs. 1D `hAdj_mod0..2` formulas (`L = 3..45` in `verify_conjecture.py` and Hypothesis pytest; golden snapshots `L = 0..6`). |
| **Property-based testing (`B10`)** | `hypothesis` strategies verifying exact algebraic invariants, $S_3$ pointwise identity (1,000 cases), consecutive-ratio Gaussian tail bounds (1,000 cases), linear/cyclic $\gamma$ identities (1,000 cases), and 2D==1D rational reduction over $L \in [3,45]$ (>3,000 total cases). |
| **Negative & adversarial tests (`B06`)** | Verifies false constants (`a_△ = 1/32`, `d_0 = 0`, constant `b_r`, zero-constant $O(L^{-2})$ remainder), invalid inputs (`n = 0`), tampered axiom logs, tampered RFC 3161 CMS signature bytes (via `openssl ts -verify`), tampered `.ots`/manifest digests, `sorry`/`@[nolint]`/`decide +native` injection, and broken citation parity are explicitly rejected. In Lean, the mathematical refutations are the proved theorems `adversarial_aTriangle_ne_one_div_32` and `adversarial_lemma_7_3_zero_const_false`; CI also runs a standalone elaboration smoke test requiring `unsolved goals` AND a live negative `sorry`-tamper `lake comparator --paranoid` rejection check. |
| **Regression tests (`B07`)** | Permanently guards fixed defects `E-2026-001`..`E-2026-020` and `F-64`..`F-83` (citation truncation, `0thernes LLC`, deterministic arXiv bundle + figures + `.bbl`, axiom sync, exact `L = 3..45` & `Theorem 2.3` fidelity parity, Table 1 exact line counts & Claim `C6`, zero local path leaks, 120-dps tail precision, `module` & SPDX headers, zero `@[nolint]`, OpenSSL X.509 RFC 3161 `.tsr` signature verification + OpenTimestamps `.ots` binding, Part 5 `Theorem 3.10`/`Proposition 4.2`/`math.PR` primary-source citation accuracy, 10-target comparator + 24-mutant report parity, Crossref `updated-by` & title/author/`primaryClass` citation verification, `Audit-Repo` honoring `B44: partial`, workflow `persist-credentials: false`, dynamic portal counts, and zero overclaimed kernel/conflict strings across docs, scripts, and rendered HTML). |
| **Golden snapshot tests (`B08`)** | Exact rational table `hAdj(0..6)` and `results/lean-axioms-all.log` theorem/definition count & sentinel checks. |
| **Differential & metamorphic tests (`B11`, `B14`)** | 2D vs. 1D exact rational differential check + 1,140-input differential oracle (`p3q_exact` vs independent `mpmath.loggamma`); permutation invariance of $(X_1, X_3)$, mod-3 shift relations, linear/cyclic asymptotic coefficient ratios. |
| **Numeric stability (`B20`)** | Cross-precision stability checks across `mp.dps = 50, 80, 120` quantifying catastrophic cancellation in $L(h_{\mathrm{adj}}(L) - c_L L - a_*)$, plus empirical $O(L^{-2})$ boundedness of $L(b_r(L)-b_r)$. |
| **Code mutation audit (`B13`)** | Isolated AST-validated source mutation runner `scripts/run_mutation_audit.py` injecting 24 semantic code mutants across 7 core verification scripts (`verify_conjecture.py`, `check_readme_axioms.py`, `check_citations.py`, `build_arxiv_bundle.py`, `stamp_timestamps.py`, `generate_manifest.py`, `check_lean_tokens.py`) behind a mandatory unmutated baseline PASS gate (`results/mutation-report.json`: 24/24 killed, 100.0%), plus constant-perturbation tests. |
| **Static analysis & types (`B17`, `B18`)** | `ruff check scripts/ tests/` and `mypy --ignore-missing-imports scripts/ tests/` (report-only). |

## Layer 3: Supply-Chain, Citation, Blueprint & Release Integrity

- `scripts/check_citations.py`: Offline static check + optional `--online` Crossref JSON (`updated-by`/`update-to`/`relation` retraction + title/author) & arXiv Atom XML (title/author/`primaryClass`) validation for all DOIs and arXiv IDs in `paper/`. It does not check cited theorem, remark, or section numbers (those are audited by hand against the live arXiv sources).
- `scripts/build_blueprint.py`: Verifies 100% of `\lean{...}` references in `blueprint/src/content.tex` exist at exact line numbers in `lean/`.
- `scripts/generate_manifest.py`: Generates and verifies `data/MANIFEST.sha256` (32 LF-deterministic entries) across frozen artifacts and logs.
- `scripts/stamp_timestamps.py`: Stamps and verifies both DigiCert RFC 3161 TSA (`openssl ts -verify` against system/certifi X.509 CA trust store) and multi-calendar Bitcoin OpenTimestamps structural binding.
- `.github/workflows/release.yml`: Produces `SHA256SUMS` and Sigstore SLSA build-provenance attestations (`actions/attest-build-provenance@v2`) on every `v*` tag.

Recorded per **Defensible Independent AI Research Playbook v1.3** (Pass 4 — Novelty & Literature / Checklist Item #15) to verify that Conjecture 7.7 (`conj:atriangle`) was genuinely open prior to our Lean 4 proof and was not already proved elsewhere in the literature.

|---|---|---|---|

(Corrected 2026-11-26: earlier revisions cited Remarks 5.3, 5.5, and 6.3, which in `arXiv:2611.14735v1` are unrelated or do not exist.) Both preprints are v1 only, with no journal reference; neither is peer reviewed. |
| 2026-11-26 | **arXiv Atom XML & Crossref JSON API (`scripts/check_citations.py --online`)** | Live resolution of all 4 unique arXiv IDs & 12 Crossref DOIs verifying HTTP 200, Crossref `updated-by` / `update-to` / `relation` retraction checks, title/author/`primaryClass` metadata matching against `paper/refs.bib`, and bidirectional `\cite`↔`refs.bib` parity | **16/16 identifiers live HTTP 200** (covering 15 of the 16 `refs.bib` entries; one textbook has no identifier), **0 retractions**, **0 title/author/`primaryClass` mismatches**, **0 missing/uncited keys**; cited theorem numbers are checked by hand against the live arXiv sources; no follow-up arXiv preprint proving Conjecture 7.7 located. |

Part 5 (2026-11-10), Remark 3.11, still describes the closed form as not proved. No earlier proof of Conjecture 7.7 found. MathSciNet and zbMATH were not searched. Log: [2026-11-26 statement audit](https://github.com/0thernes/0thernes-research-archive/blob/main/docs/reviews/2026-11-26-statement-audit.md). |

=== docs/configuration.md ===

# Configuration & Environments (`docs/configuration.md`)

This project uses **no runtime environment variables, secrets, API keys, or external services**. All configuration is declarative and committed in version-controlled manifests.

## Configuration Files

| File | Purpose | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `VERSION` | Single source of truth for semantic version (read dynamically by scripts & tests) | Must match `CHANGELOG.md`, `CITATION.cff`, `formalization.yaml`, `lean/lakefile.toml`, `llms.txt`, and `docs/media/social-preview.svg`. |
| `lean/lean-toolchain` | Pinned Lean 4 release (`leanprover/lean4:v4.35.0`) | Automatically respected by `elan` and `lake`. |
| `lean/lakefile.toml` | Lean package targets, `autoImplicit = false`, `weak.linter.mathlibStandardSet = true`, Batteries `lintDriver` | Defines `MultinomialTVConjecture`, `Challenge`, `Solution`, `VerifyAxioms`. |
| `lean/lake-manifest.json` | Exact Git commit lockfile for `mathlib`, `batteries`, `Qq`, `aesop`, etc. | Never edit by hand; update only intentionally with a full `lake comparator --paranoid` re-verification. |
| `lean/comparator.json` | Target theorems & permitted axioms for `lake comparator --paranoid` (10 targets) | Maps `Challenge` -> `Solution` with `[propext, Quot.sound, Classical.choice]`. |
| `requirements.txt` | Pinned Python dependencies for verification, pytest, schema validation, linting | Install via `python3 -m pip install -r requirements.txt`. |
| `repo.yaml` | Build Standard v1.2.0 machine-readable manifest | Validated against `repo-standard.schema.json`. |
| `formalization.yaml` | Palomar-compatible authorship, CRediT, toolchain, and AI provenance record | Human- and machine-readable YAML. |
| `.gitleaks.toml` | Secret-scanner allowlist excluding audit scripts' own regex definitions | Used by `gitleaks` in CI. |

## Platform-Specific Notes

- **Linux (Ubuntu 24.04 CI):** Install `bubblewrap` (`sudo apt-get install -y bubblewrap`) for sandboxed `lake comparator --config comparator.json --paranoid`. If Ubuntu 24.04 restricts unprivileged user namespaces, allow userns with `sudo sysctl -w kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=0` (see `.github/workflows/lean-verify.yml`).
- **Windows (PowerShell):** When storing the repository under paths containing square brackets (e.g. `C:\Projects\[MyRepo]\...`), always pass `-LiteralPath` to PowerShell file cmdlets (`Audit-Repo.ps1` uses `-LiteralPath` and `[System.IO.Path]::Combine` throughout). Upstream Lean 4.35.0 `lake comparator` requires Linux `bubblewrap`; on Windows, invoke the 5 bundled standalone checkers directly on `leanexport` output or run the full `lake comparator` (six checker runs) inside WSL2/Docker/Ubuntu CI.
- **macOS:** Python test suite, Blueprint, and Lean builds run natively; run the full sandboxed `lake comparator` inside a Linux container or Ubuntu CI.

=== docs/threat-model.md ===

# Threat Model (`docs/threat-model.md`)

Because this repository is a mathematical proof and research artifact (no network daemon, no user accounts, no personal data), the primary assets at risk are **epistemic integrity**, **formal soundness**, **bibliographic accuracy**, and **build-chain authenticity**.

## Threat Matrix

| Threat ID | Threat | Impact | Likelihood | Concrete Mitigations |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **T1** | **Proof soundness bypass** (`sorry`, custom `axiom`, `native_decide`, `decide +native`, `unsafe`, `implemented_by`, `@[extern]`, `@[nolint]`, or meta-level environment tampering) | False mathematical claim presented as Lean-verified | Medium if unchecked | Centralized nested-comment/string-aware forbidden-token & zero-`@[nolint]` scanner (`scripts/check_lean_tokens.py`) in CI, `dev.sh`, and `pytest`; exhaustive `Lean.collectAxioms` metaprogram auditing all theorems AND definitions in `VerifyAxioms.lean`; six checker runs of `lake comparator --paranoid` + live negative `sorry`-tamper comparator rejection check. |
| **T2** | **Definition drift / vacuous formalization** (Lean proves a trivially true or subtly altered version of Conjecture 7.7) | Formal proof passes kernels but does not prove Banić & Elezović's actual conjecture | Medium | Isolated 164-line Mathlib-only `lean/Challenge.lean` (`module` header, 10 targets incl. literal Part 2 §7.2 `target_gamma3_source_form`) with verbatim nested multinomial sum; 22 non-vacuity and adversarial false-constant/non-degeneracy refutation theorems in `NonVacuity.lean` (6 direct `hAdj 0..5` definition checks + 16 closed-form corollaries covering all 10 targets, independently replayed via `lake env leanchecker MultinomialTVConjecture.NonVacuity`); standalone mutated-constant elaboration smoke test requiring `unsolved goals`; `docs/statement-fidelity.md` audit table; independent Python exact rational + 80-digit oracle. |
| **T3** | **README / paper claim drift** (human/AI edits manuscript or README without updating verified logs) | Published prose contradicts verified Lean output | Medium | `scripts/check_readme_axioms.py --require-exhaustive` enforces verbatim sync and exact theorem count between `README.md` and `results/lean-axioms-all.log`; `scripts/build_blueprint.py` validates every `\lean{...}` symbol against actual Lean files; `tests/test_repo_integrity.py` verifies exact `paper/main.tex` Table 1 line counts and dynamic portal theorem counts. |
| **T4** | **Citation hallucination or identifier corruption** (e.g., truncated arXiv ID `2610.1336` caught in `E-2026-001`) | Broken or false scholarly attribution | High in AI-assisted writing | `scripts/check_citations.py` static + `--online` Crossref JSON / arXiv Atom XML verifier checking live HTTP 200, title/author/`primaryClass` match against `paper/refs.bib`, Crossref `updated-by`/`update-to`/`relation` retraction checks, and bidirectional `\cite`↔`refs.bib` parity; regression & mutation tests permanently guarding `2610.13366`, retractions, and metadata mismatches. |
| **T5** | **Supply-chain / CI tampering** (compromised Mathlib cache, Python package, or release artifact) | Malicious code execution or tampered PDF/tarball | Low–Medium | Pinned `lean/lake-manifest.json` commits, pinned `requirements.txt` (`pytest==9.0.3`, `pygments==2.20.0`, 0 Dependabot alerts, 0 OSV CVEs), `persist-credentials: false` across all 4 workflows, `data/MANIFEST.sha256` (32 LF entries), dual cryptographic timestamps (X.509-verified DigiCert RFC 3161 `MANIFEST.sha256.tsr` via `openssl ts -verify` + Bitcoin OpenTimestamps `MANIFEST.sha256.ots`), release `SHA256SUMS`, Sigstore SLSA `actions/attest-build-provenance@v2` verified via `gh attestation verify`, `gitleaks` + SHA-256-verified `osv-scanner v2.7.1`, strict CSP + `sha384` SRI on GitHub Pages, and isolated AST code-mutation auditing (`scripts/run_mutation_audit.py`, 24/24 killed). |
| **T6** | **Path-handling / shell-injection bugs** (e.g., PowerShell wildcard expansion on bracketed paths like `C:\Projects\[MyRepo]`) | Broken local builds or misdiagnosed missing files | Medium on Windows | All PowerShell scripts (`Audit-Repo.ps1`) use `-LiteralPath` and `[System.IO.Path]::Combine`; Python scripts use `pathlib.Path`, temp-dir OpenSSL staging (`stamp_timestamps.py`), and list-form `subprocess.run(..., shell=False, encoding="utf-8")`. |

## Residual Risk & Export-Control Self-Screen

- **Residual epistemic risk:** Independent human line-by-line review of `lean/Challenge.lean` against `arXiv:2610.17046v1` remains open (`human_line_by_line_review_recorded: false`). Readers can audit `lean/Challenge.lean` (164 lines) directly in under 5 minutes.
- **Export-control self-screen (EAR 15 CFR 734.8 / ITAR 22 CFR 120):** Pure fundamental mathematical research in probability and statistics with zero cryptographic, military, or dual-use software.

=== docs/operations.md ===

# Operations, Backups & Offsite Mirror (`docs/operations.md`)

Although `multinomial-tv-conjecture` is a static research and formal-proof repository with no live backend, long-term scientific preservation requires verifiable backups, checksums, and offsite mirrors.

## 1. Cryptographic Integrity & Artifact Manifests

Frozen PDFs, arXiv submission tarballs, verification logs, and data artifacts are hashed in `data/MANIFEST.sha256` via:

```bash
python3 scripts/generate_manifest.py --write
python3 scripts/generate_manifest.py --verify
```

Every `v*` Git tag triggers `.github/workflows/release.yml`, publishing:
- Compiled PDF (`Donahue_2026_Conjecture_7_7_Multinomial_TV.pdf`)
- Byte-reproducible arXiv source bundle (`arxiv_submission.tar.gz`)
- Live axiom audit log (`lean-axioms-all.log`)
- Data manifest (`data-MANIFEST.sha256`), X.509-verified DigiCert RFC 3161 timestamp (`data-MANIFEST.sha256.tsr`, verified via `openssl ts -verify`), and Bitcoin OpenTimestamps proof (`data-MANIFEST.sha256.ots`)
- `SHA256SUMS` + Sigstore SLSA build-provenance attestations (`actions/attest-build-provenance@v2`).

## 2. Creating an Offline Git Bundle Backup

Create a self-contained single-file archival backup of all branches and tags:

```bash
git bundle create multinomial-tv-conjecture-$(cat VERSION).bundle --all
git bundle verify multinomial-tv-conjecture-$(cat VERSION).bundle
sha256sum multinomial-tv-conjecture-$(cat VERSION).bundle
```

Store the verified `.bundle` file on an external drive or secondary cloud storage independent of GitHub.

## 3. Offsite Mirrors & Archival Preservation

1. **Master Research Archive mirror:** Pinned as a Git submodule with frozen PDF, arXiv tarball, and SHA-256 registry entry inside [`0thernes/0thernes-research-archive`](https://github.com/0thernes/0thernes-research-archive) (`0TH-2026-006`).
2. **Software Heritage (SWH) public archival:** Software Heritage's unauthenticated Save Code Now endpoint (`https://archive.softwareheritage.org/api/1/origin/save/git/url/https://github.com/0thernes/multinomial-tv-conjecture/`) is currently gated by an Anubis proof-of-work anti-bot challenge, so obtaining an immutable `swh:1:rev:` identifier requires a manual browser submission at `https://archive.softwareheritage.org/save/` (tracked honestly as open in `docs/run-log.md` and `ROADMAP.md`).
3. **Optional Git remote mirror:** To mirror to a secondary host (e.g., Codeberg or GitLab):
   ```bash
   git remote add mirror <mirror-url>
   git push --mirror mirror
   ```

## 4. Data & Schema Migrations

No mutable database exists. Any future schema upgrade to `repo.yaml` (`repo-standard.schema.json`), `formalization.yaml`, or `lean/lean-toolchain` is tracked in `CHANGELOG.md` and verified via `tests/test_repo_integrity.py` and `scripts/audit-repo.sh`.

=== docs/faq.md ===

# Frequently Asked Questions (`docs/faq.md`)

### 1. What exact open problem does this repository solve?
It proves **Conjecture 7.7** (`conj:atriangle`) and the complete quantitative $O(L^{-2})$ remainder of **Lemma 7.3** of Nikola Banić and Neven Elezović, *Discrete total variation under the multinomial, Part 2: variance under the uniform null* (`arXiv:2610.17046v1`, 2026), establishing exact values for all three residue limits $b_0 = \frac{32\sqrt{3}}{81\pi}$, $b_1 = b_2 = -\frac{22\sqrt{3}}{81\pi}$, the mean $d_0 = -\frac{4\sqrt{3}}{81\pi}$, the triangular constant $a_\triangle = \frac{1}{32} - \frac{4\sqrt{3}}{243}$, and the quadratic coefficient $\gamma_2 = -\frac{1}{32\pi} - \frac{8\sqrt{3}}{243\pi}$. This removes the sole conjectural input from the Banić–Elezović formulas for $\gamma(n)$ (Part 2, Thm 7.6) and cyclic $\gamma_c(n)$ (Part 5, `arXiv:2611.14735v1`, Thm 3.10); those formulas still rest on the cited theorems of those preprints, which are not formalized here. The source is an arXiv v1 preprint (posted 2026-10-12) that has not been peer reviewed, and Part 5 (Remark 3.11) still lists the closed form as unproved.

### 2. Is this problem listed in the 2,000-problem Unsolved Problems Mega-Atlas?
**No.** Conjecture 7.7 is a specialized 2026 preprint conjecture in discrete probability/asymptotics; it is not one of the 2,000 grand macro open problems in `0thernes/unsolved-problems-mega-atlas` (`v2.9.0`, `59` `STAT-*` entries). We explicitly do **not** claim retirement of any Mega-Atlas grand problem.

### 3. Why does `lean/Challenge.lean` contain 10 `sorry` statements?
By design of Lean's `lake comparator` (Palomar-style specification isolation): `Challenge.lean` imports **only Mathlib** (zero files from our proof library) and states the 10 target theorems with `sorry` stubs. `lake comparator --config comparator.json --paranoid` then checks that sorry-free `Solution.lean` exports the same statements as `Challenge.lean` and replays the proof terms in **six checker runs** (the Lean kernel in paranoid and default mode, `lean4lean`, `nanoda`, `con-leche`, `con-ron`). None of our proof modules (`MultinomialTVConjecture/*`, `Solution.lean`) contain any `sorry`.

### 4. Does Lean 4 prove Banić & Elezović's Theorem 7.6 and Part 5 Theorem 3.10?
**No.** Lean 4 proves Conjecture 7.7 and the quantitative $O(L^{-2})$ Lemma 7.3 remainder from Mathlib with only the three standard axioms, and proves the algebraic identities `gamma_closed_form`, `gamma_cyclic_closed_form`, `gamma3_closed_form`, `gamma3_source_form`, and `gamma4_closed_form` for the $(p_1, q_1, r_1)$ combinations stated in Part 2 (Theorem 7.6, §7.2, §8) and Part 5 (Theorem 3.10). Lean defines no random variable or variance. Those upstream variance decompositions are cited literature results outside our Lean boundary (see [LIMITATIONS.md](../LIMITATIONS.md)).

### 5. Why are there both `LICENSE` (Apache-2.0) and `LICENSE-DOCS` (CC-BY-4.0)?
Following independent scientific publishing best practices (Playbook v1.3 and Mathlib4 upstream compatibility), software and Lean formalizations use **Apache-2.0** (patent grant + clean upstreaming to Mathlib4), while the research manuscript, figures, blueprint, and documentation use **CC-BY-4.0** (attribution-preserving scholarly reuse).

### 6. How can I verify the proof in under a minute without trusting the author?
1. Read `lean/Challenge.lean` (164 lines, Mathlib-only, Lean 4.35.0 `module` header, 10 targets) to confirm the theorem statements match Banić & Elezović (`arXiv:2610.17046v1`).
2. Run `cd lean && lake exe cache get && lake build MultinomialTVConjecture Challenge Solution VerifyAxioms && lake env lean VerifyAxioms.lean && lake env leanchecker MultinomialTVConjecture.NonVacuity`.
3. On Linux with `bubblewrap` (or WSL2/Docker), run `lake comparator --config comparator.json --paranoid`.

=== docs/glossary.md ===

# Glossary (`docs/glossary.md`)

## Mathematical Terms

- **Discrete Total Variation ($D_n$):** For a multinomial count vector $(X_1, \dots, X_n) \sim \mathrm{Mult}(N; 1/n, \dots, 1/n)$, the sum of adjacent absolute differences $D_n = \sum_{i=1}^{n-1} |X_{i+1} - X_i|$ (or cyclic $D_n^{(c)} = D_n + |X_1 - X_n|$).
- **Adjacent Pair Expectation ($h_{\mathrm{adj}}(L)$):** The exact expectation $\mathbb{E}[|X_2 - X_1|\,|X_3 - X_2|]$ for $(X_1, X_2, X_3) \sim \mathrm{Mult}(L; \frac13, \frac13, \frac13)$.
- **Residue Constants ($b_0, b_1, b_2$):** The mod-3 sub-sequence limits $b_r = \lim_{q\to\infty} (3q+r)(h_{\mathrm{adj}}(3q+r) - c_L(3q+r) - a_*)$ for $r \in \{0,1,2\}$.
- **Mean Residue Constant ($d_0$):** The average $d_0 = \frac{1}{3}(b_0 + b_1 + b_2) = -\frac{4\sqrt{3}}{81\pi}$.
- **Adjacent Triangular-Lattice Constant ($a_\triangle$):** $a_\triangle = \frac{1}{32} + \frac{\pi}{9}(b_0 + b_1 + b_2) = \frac{1}{32} - \frac{4\sqrt{3}}{243}$.
- **Second-Order Variance Coefficients ($\gamma(n), \gamma_c(n), \gamma_2$):** The $O(N^{-2})$ coefficients in the large-$N$ asymptotic expansions of the normalized variances $\mathrm{Var}(d)/N$ and $\mathrm{Var}(d^c)/N$ (equivalently the $O(N^{-1})$ coefficients of $\mathrm{Var}(d)$ and $\mathrm{Var}(d^c)$, one order beyond the $O(1)$ constant $-\beta(n)$), with quadratic leading coefficient $\gamma_2 = \frac{64 a_\triangle - 3}{32\pi} = -\frac{1}{32\pi} - \frac{8\sqrt{3}}{243\pi}$.

## Formal Verification Terms

- **Six checker runs (`lake comparator --paranoid`):** Replaying a single proof export in six checker passes: the Lean 4.35.0 kernel in paranoid and default mode, `lean4lean`, `nanoda`, `con-leche`, and `con-ron`. Two of the six are the Lean kernel.
- **Palomar Isolation (`Challenge.lean` / `Solution.lean`):** Separating minimal Mathlib-only target specifications from proof internals so auditors only inspect the concise `Challenge.lean` statement file (164 lines, well under Palomar's 1,000-line / 100 KiB limit).
- **Statement Fidelity:** Exact mathematical correspondence between an informal literature statement and its formal Lean 4 type.
- **Non-Vacuity Witness:** A formal theorem proving that hypotheses are concretely inhabited and that definitions evaluate to known exact values and refute deliberately false variants.
- **Standard Lean Axioms:** `[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]` — the three foundational axioms of classical mathematics in Lean 4 / Mathlib4.

## Ten Finding Classes (Build Standard v1.2.0 Rule `R7`)

| Class | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `bug` | Code does something different from its spec or intent (a defect in program logic). |
| `error` | Wrong number, claim, doc, config, version, build, or command. |
| `issue` | Works and is not wrong, but is unclear, inconsistent, fragile, or hard to maintain. |
| `problem` | External obstacle (network, account, toolchain, legal-entity status) blocks progress or validity. |
| `concern` | Risk that has not caused harm yet (security, cost, legal, reliability). |
| `dilemma` | Trade-off between valid options; the owner decides. |
| `conflict` | Two requirements or rules contradict each other. |
| `gap` | Something required or expected is missing; nothing present is wrong. |
| `hole` | Missing check or safeguard, so a defect could pass unnoticed. |
| `blindspot` | A user, platform, failure mode, or assumption nobody has examined yet. |
